rules: 14 eyalette devlet üniversitelerinde 0 €/sömestre
Baden-Württemberg dışındaki devlet üniversitelerinin çoğunda genel öğrenim ücreti yok; Baden-Württemberg ve TUM gibi bazı üniversiteler AB/AEA dışından gelen öğrencilerden ücret alıyor
DAAD'a göre 2.500+ İngilizce master programı var — Almanca öğrenmek zorunda kalmazsın
Almanca bilmeden başvurabileceğin İngilizce programlar var; dil koşulunu her program kendisi belirler ([İngilizce programlar](/tr/english-taught))

İngilizce eğitim veriliyorsa:
- IELTS 6.5+ (bazı top üni'ler 7.0)
- TOEFL iBT 88+ (top üni'ler 100+)
- Cambridge CAE (C1 Advanced)
- Bazı üni'ler Duolingo English Test 110+ kabul ediyor (post-COVID standart)

**İngilizce eğitim** veriliyorsa kabul edilen sınavları ve puanları program belirler. Kontrol ettiğimiz resmî örneklerde istenen seviye B2 ile C1 arasında değişiyor; bazı programlar önceki İngilizce eğitimini sınav yerine sayıyor, bazıları saymıyor. Örnekler ve ayrıntılar: [Almanca bilmeden İngilizce yüksek lisans](/tr/blog/english-masters-in-germany-without-german-knowledge-finding-programs-and-application) · [İngilizce eğitim veren üniversiteler](/tr/universities/collections/english-taught-universities)

DAAD veritabanında 2.500+ tamamen İngilizce master programı var. Almanca bilgisi sıfır olsa da bu programlara başvuru ve eğitim İngilizce yapılır. Ancak günlük hayat için A2-B1 seviyesi Almanca öğrenmek pratiktir.

Almanca bilmeden başvurabileceğin İngilizce yüksek lisans programları var. Ama dil koşulunu her program kendisi belirler ve bazı programlar belli bir aşamada temel Almanca isteyebilir; günlük yaşamda da Almanca işini kolaylaştırır. Ayrıntılar: [İngilizce yüksek lisans rehberi](/tr/blog/english-masters-in-germany-without-german-knowledge-finding-programs-and-application).
14 eyalette evet, Baden-Württemberg'de AB dışı için 1.500 €/sömestre.

Çoğu devlet üniversitesinde genel öğrenim ücreti yok; Baden-Württemberg AB dışından gelen öğrencilerden 1.500 €/sömestre alıyor ve TUM gibi bazı üniversiteler AB/AEA dışından gelen öğrencilerden kendi ücretini alıyor. Dönem katkı payı (Semesterbeitrag) her yerde ayrıca ödenir.
0 €/semester at public Universitäten in 14 Bundesländer
no general tuition fees at most public universities outside Baden-Württemberg; Baden-Württemberg and some universities such as TUM charge students from outside the EU/EEA
According to the DAAD, there are 2,500+ English Master's programs – you don't have to learn German
There are English-taught programmes you can apply to without German; each programme sets its own language requirement ([English-taught programmes](/en/english-taught))

If the education is in English:
- IELTS 6.5+ (some top Universitäten 7.0)
- TOEFL iBT 88+ (top Universitäten 100+)
- Cambridge CAE (C1 Advanced)
- Some Universitäten accept Duolingo English Test 110+ (post-COVID standard)

If the programme is taught in **English**, the programme decides which tests and scores it accepts. In the official examples we checked, the required level ranges from B2 to C1; some programmes accept a previous degree taught in English instead of a test and some do not. Examples and details: [English-taught Master's in Germany without German](/en/blog/english-masters-in-germany-without-german-knowledge-finding-programs-and-application-en) · [Universities with English-taught programmes](/en/universities/collections/english-taught-universities)

The DAAD database lists 2,500+ fully English-taught Master's programs. Even with zero German knowledge, you can apply to these programs and study in English. However, learning A2-B1 level German is practical for daily life.

There are English-taught Master's programmes you can apply to without German. Each programme sets its own language requirement, and some expect basic German at a certain stage; German also makes everyday life easier. Details: [English-taught Master's guide](/en/blog/english-masters-in-germany-without-german-knowledge-finding-programs-and-application-en).
In 14 Bundesländer, yes. In Baden-Württemberg, it's 1,500 €/semester for non-EU students.

Most public universities charge no general tuition fees; Baden-Württemberg charges students from outside the EU 1,500 €/semester, and some universities such as TUM charge students from outside the EU/EEA their own fees. The semester contribution (Semesterbeitrag) is paid everywhere.
0 €/Semester an staatlichen Universitäten in 14 Bundesländern

an den meisten staatlichen Universitäten außerhalb Baden-Württembergs keine allgemeinen Studiengebühren; Baden-Württemberg und einzelne Hochschulen wie die TUM verlangen von Studierenden aus Nicht-EU/EWR-Staaten Gebühren
Laut DAAD gibt es über 2.500 englischsprachige Masterprogramme – du musst nicht unbedingt Deutsch lernen
Es gibt englischsprachige Studiengänge, für die du dich ohne Deutsch bewerben kannst; die Sprachanforderung legt jeder Studiengang selbst fest ([englischsprachige Studiengänge](/de/english-taught))

Wenn der Unterricht auf Englisch erfolgt:
- IELTS 6.5+ (einige Top-Universitäten 7.0)
- TOEFL iBT 88+ (Top-Universitäten 100+)
- Cambridge CAE (C1 Advanced)
- Einige Universitäten akzeptieren den Duolingo English Test 110+ (Post-COVID-Standard)

Wenn der Unterricht **auf Englisch** erfolgt, legt der Studiengang fest, welche Tests und Ergebnisse gelten. In den geprüften offiziellen Beispielen reicht das verlangte Niveau von B2 bis C1; manche Studiengänge erkennen ein englischsprachiges Vorstudium statt eines Tests an, andere nicht. Beispiele und Details: [Englischsprachiger Master ohne Deutschkenntnisse](/de/blog/english-masters-in-germany-without-german-knowledge-finding-programs-and-application-de) · [Universitäten mit englischsprachigen Studiengängen](/de/universities/collections/english-taught-universities)

In der DAAD-Datenbank gibt es über 2.500 komplett englischsprachige Masterprogramme. Auch wenn du keine Deutschkenntnisse hast, kannst du dich für diese Programme bewerben und das Studium auf Englisch absolvieren. Für den Alltag ist es jedoch praktisch, Deutsch auf A2-B1-Niveau zu lernen.

Es gibt englischsprachige Masterstudiengänge, für die du dich ohne Deutschkenntnisse bewerben kannst. Die Sprachanforderung legt aber jeder Studiengang selbst fest, und manche verlangen zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt Grundkenntnisse in Deutsch; im Alltag macht Deutsch vieles leichter. Details: [Leitfaden zum englischsprachigen Master](/de/blog/english-masters-in-germany-without-german-knowledge-finding-programs-and-application-de).
In 14 Bundesländern ja, in Baden-Württemberg 1.500 €/Semester für Nicht-EU-Bürger.

An den meisten staatlichen Universitäten gibt es keine allgemeinen Studiengebühren; Baden-Württemberg verlangt von Nicht-EU-Studierenden 1.500 €/Semester, und einzelne Hochschulen wie die TUM erheben von Studierenden aus Nicht-EU/EWR-Staaten eigene Gebühren. Der Semesterbeitrag fällt überall an.
